components.css: .ds-panel { border: 1px solid #2a2e36; border-radius: 6px; background: #181b20; color: #e6e8eb; overflow: hidden; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-panel-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding: 10px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid #2a2e36; } .ds-panel-head h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-panel-head span { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; color: #868d98; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-panel-row { padding: 12px 16px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-panel-row + .ds-panel-row { border-top: 1px solid #2a2e36; } .ds-panel-row small { display: block; margin-top: 2px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 400; color: #e6e8eb; }

components.name: Pipeline Strip
components.description: Signature: stage boxes joined by connectors; done = green border + muted value, active = blue.
components.html:
1. 來源譜面 + 音效
  2. 設定MASTER 13+
  3. 生成尚未開始
components.css: .ds-pipe { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 14px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-stage { position: relative; min-width: 0; padding: 10px 10px 9px; border: 1px solid #2a2e36; border-radius: 6px; background: #181b20; color: #868d98; transition: border-color .3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), background-color .3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-stage + .ds-stage::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 50%; right: 100%; width: 14px; height: 2px; margin-top: -1px; background: #3a3f4a; } .ds-stage b { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #a3a9b3; } .ds-stage span { display: block; margin-top: 4px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-done { border-color: rgba(95,211,141,.45); color: #5fd38d; } .ds-done b { color: #e6e8eb; } .ds-done span { color: #a3a9b3; } .ds-done + .ds-stage::before { background: #5fd38d; } .ds-active { border-color: #6cb6ff; background: rgba(108,182,255,.12); color: #6cb6ff; } .ds-active b { color: #e6e8eb; } .ds-stage.ds-active::before { background: #6cb6ff; }

components.name: Metrics Row
components.description: Seamed 3-column grid of mono figures; the total in signal blue.
components.css: .ds-metrics { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); border: 1px solid #2a2e36; border-radius: 6px; background: #181b20; color: #e6e8eb; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-metrics > div { padding: 12px 16px; min-width: 0; } .ds-metrics > div + div { border-left: 1px solid #2a2e36; } .ds-metrics small { display: block; margin-bottom: 4px; font-size: 12px; color: #868d98; } .ds-metrics strong { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-total { color: #6cb6ff; }

components.name: Sticky Action Bar
components.description: Full-width bottom bar holding the single primary action; there is no top navigation.
components.css: .ds-action-bar { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding: 12px 24px; border-top: 1px solid #2a2e36; background: rgba(17,19,23,.94); backdrop-filter: blur(10px); color: #e6e8eb; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-action-bar small { display: block; font-size: 11px; color: #868d98; } .ds-action-bar strong { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; color: #6cb6ff; } .ds-action-bar button { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 18px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: #6cb6ff; color: #08131f; font: inherit; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-action-bar button:hover { background: #95caff; } .ds-action-bar button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6cb6ff; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
A dark working console where each tool's job runs as a visible pipeline. The visitor sees which stage they are in, fills the open stage, watches stages turn green, and downloads. Everything sits on a graphite ground, with panels one tonal step up, divided by 1px seams. There are no shadows, no gradients, and no floating cards.

The density is compact, like developer tools: small semibold labels, mono figures, seamed rows instead of separate boxes. Color does work and nothing else. One signal blue marks the primary action and the active stage. Green and red appear only for success and error. Amber appears only for Break. Everything else is graphite and grey text.

The tool pages have no navigation bar and no home link. That is the user's decision. Each page starts with its title.
keyCharacteristics: Graphite ground, tonal panel steps, 1px seams, zero shadows.
A pipeline strip of stage boxes as the signature, driven live by app state.
Panel headers: semibold label left, mono count right.
One filled signal-blue button per viewport, pinned in a sticky bottom action bar.
Noto Sans TC for UI; JetBrains Mono (tabular) for figures, file names, and counts.

rules.name: The Reserved Hue Rule
rules.body: Green means success, red means error, amber means Break. None of them is ever used for decoration, emphasis, or variety.

rules.name: The Muted Done Rule
rules.body: A done stage turns its border and icon green, but its value stays text-muted. Completion is signalled by the icon, not by bright text.

rules.name: The Mono Means Data Rule
rules.body: File names, counts, durations, ratings, and stage values are set in JetBrains Mono with tabular numerals. Prose and labels never are.

rules.name: The Seam Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: Panels are separated by a 1px border or a tonal step, never by a shadow.

dos: Do start every tool page with title and lede, then the pipeline strip, then panels.
Do keep exactly one filled signal-blue button per viewport, in the sticky action bar.
Do separate surfaces with 1px seams and tonal steps.
Do set counts, file names, and figures in JetBrains Mono with tabular numerals.
Do use the 6px radius for every bordered element.
Do load fonts through next/font and keep ToolPunct first in the sans stack.
donts: Don't add a navigation bar or home link to tool pages.
Don't use amber for anything but Break, or green/red for anything but success/error.
Don't brighten done-stage values. They stay muted.
Don't add shadows, gradients, or floating cards.
Don't apply these rules to the home page or to the canvas-drawn Rating chart PNG.
